description: The `#include` preprocessor for WGSL. Deliberately minimal: textual substitution of whole files from public/shaders, nothing else. No macros, no conditionals, no expressions, no include guards — a shader that includes the same library twice is an error, not a silent no-op, because duplicate WGSL declarations are. Implemented once in src/wasm/bridge/wgslInclude.ts (emitted to both bridge copies) and mirrored for the Python bindgroup checker in scripts/wgsl_include.py; the two are held byte-identical by scripts/verify-wgsl-include.mjs against the fixtures in scripts/fixtures/wgsl_include/.

directive.notes: Whole-line only, one per line. A directive inside a // or /* */ comment is NOT expanded; a directive inside a string literal cannot occur because WGSL has none.

rules.libraryPrefixReason: Only `_`-prefixed files may be included. They are excluded from the shader manifest by generate_shader_lists.js and from the gates by bindgroup_checker.py TEMPLATE_FILES, so including one cannot pull a shipped catalog effect into another shader (a 2k-line effect silently inlined into a second effect).
rules.flatRootReason: public/shaders is a flat directory — 1417 files, no subfolders. A path separator in an include is rejected rather than resolved, which also rules out traversal (../, absolute paths).
rules.cycleDetection: An include chain that revisits a file already on the stack is an error naming the full cycle.
rules.repeatInclude: Including the same file twice anywhere in one expansion is an error: WGSL has no include guards and a duplicated declaration does not compile.

lineDirectives.reason: Expansion shifts line numbers, so naga diagnostics would point at the wrong source line. The marker comments let a reader map an expanded line back to its origin. They are comments, so they cost nothing at compile time.

consumers.cppNote: C++ does NOT parse includes. Every byte of WGSL reaches LoadShader as a string that already passed through src/wasm/bridge/shader.ts, so the C++ side only asserts that no directive survived and fails loudly if one did.

migration.note: Shaders are converted one at a time. 1417 catalog files are NOT rewritten. A file with no #include is returned unchanged, byte for byte.
